capabilities: Highlight text in the active note that matches a match-syntax query
Search using part-of-speech tags, wildcards, and greedy or optional matching
Combine AND logic, negative matches, and JavaScript regex in one query
Keep highlights until manually cleared via a setting
disambiguation: Not a syntax highlighter for code; it highlights note text that matches query patterns.
extras: Matching works only with English grammar; other languages are not supported. A TODO list lists planned features such as custom tags and a match count in the status bar.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches literal text or regex but cannot match by grammatical part-of-speech, wildcards, or fuzzy text patterns inside the active note.

relations.evidence: MatchSyntax heavily depends on the compromise library

summary: Search tool that highlights parts of the active note matching queries written in the compromise match syntax.
